How it works

Three steps. Zero extra work.

  1. 1

    Customer sends a message

    Any time, in any of 8 languages. “2 kurtay chahiye.”

  2. 2

    AI answers and books the order

    Using only your products, prices and delivery rules. It collects name, address and payment, then sends a receipt with an order number.

  3. 3

    You tap one button

    Paid, Dispatched or Cancel — right inside WhatsApp. Your customer is told automatically.

Languages

Speaks your customer’s language.

Urdu, Roman Urdu, English, Arabic, Farsi, Spanish, Hindi and Italian. The AI replies in the language the customer writes in — and politely keeps the chat about your shop.

  • Answers only from your own price list — never invents prices
  • Politely refuses off-topic questions
  • Remembers returning customers and their past orders

Orders

Orders with receipts and order numbers.

Product, quantity, name, address and payment method — collected in the chat, confirmed, and sent back as a clean receipt like #ALI-0012.

  • Customer can switch payment method after booking (COD to JazzCash, etc.)
  • Customer can cancel before dispatch
  • Online payments use a slightly odd amount like PKR 5,199.72, so you spot each payment instantly — never more than the total

Payment check

Checks payment screenshots for you.

The AI reads the amount, transaction ID, date and receiver. It rejects photos that are not receipts and warns you when something looks wrong:

  • Amount is lower than due
  • Money went to a different account
  • Screenshot looks edited
  • Same screenshot or transaction ID was used for another order

⚠️No AI can catch every fake. Always confirm the payment in your own bank or JazzCash app before you dispatch.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Do I need a new number?

Usually yes — a number that is not already on WhatsApp. Or send us your current number and we will check if it can be connected.

Can it cancel or refund?

Yes. Customers can cancel before dispatch. You can cancel, mark refunded or returned with one line (cancel 18, refunded 18, returned 18), and undo if needed. Every action asks a quick Yes/No, then the customer is told automatically.

Is my data safe?

Each business has its own separate setup — its own number, products, prices and customers. Your data is used to run your shop’s assistant. Please read our Privacy Policy for full details.

Which languages does it speak?

Urdu, Roman Urdu, English, Arabic, Farsi, Spanish, Hindi and Italian. The Silver plan covers Urdu, Roman Urdu and English; Gold and Premium include all languages.

What if the AI makes a mistake?

It only answers from your own products and prices, and stays on topic. You confirm every payment yourself in your own bank or JazzCash app, and complaints go straight to your team with numbers like C1.

Can I use it outside Pakistan?

Yes. Each business has its own currency and time zone. Plans abroad start at USD 29/month.
